articles.title: Anthropic Releases Claude 4 With Extended Reasoning and 1M Token Context
articles.summary: Anthropic has officially launched Claude 4, featuring a massive one-million token context window and enhanced chain-of-thought reasoning capabilities. The model reportedly outperforms competitors on several coding and mathematical benchmarks. Anthropic also announced new enterprise pricing tiers aimed at large-scale deployment.

articles.title: OpenAI's Operator Agents Now Available to All ChatGPT Plus Subscribers
articles.summary: OpenAI has rolled out its browser-based Operator agent system to all ChatGPT Plus users after a months-long limited beta. The agentic tool can autonomously browse the web, fill forms, and complete multi-step tasks on behalf of users. Early reviews highlight strong performance in travel booking and online shopping workflows.

articles.title: Google DeepMind Publishes Gemini Ultra 2 Multimodal Benchmark Results
articles.summary: Google DeepMind released a comprehensive technical report showing Gemini Ultra 2 achieving state-of-the-art scores across video understanding, audio reasoning, and image-text tasks. The model demonstrates a significant leap in real-time video analysis, processing up to 10 hours of footage in a single pass. Researchers say the results push the frontier of natively multimodal architectures.

articles.title: EU AI Act Enforcement Agency Issues First Major Fines to Two Tech Firms
articles.summary: The newly operational EU AI Enforcement Agency levied fines totaling €48 million against two unnamed technology companies for deploying high-risk AI systems without proper conformity assessments. The action marks the first significant regulatory enforcement under the EU AI Act, which entered full effect earlier this year. Industry groups are urging clearer compliance guidelines ahead of further enforcement actions.

articles.title: Microsoft Integrates RAG-Powered Copilot Directly Into Azure SQL Database
articles.summary: Microsoft announced that its Copilot assistant now features native retrieval-augmented generation built directly into Azure SQL Database, allowing enterprises to query structured data using natural language. The integration eliminates the need for external vector databases in many common enterprise use cases. Customers in the preview program report up to 60 percent reduction in time spent writing complex queries.

articles.title: Stanford HAI Report Warns of Accelerating AI-Enabled Misinformation in 2026 Elections
articles.summary: A new report from Stanford's Human-Centered AI Institute documents a sharp rise in AI-generated political misinformation across social media platforms in the lead-up to several national elections this year. Researchers found that detection tools are struggling to keep pace with increasingly sophisticated synthetic media. The report calls for mandatory watermarking standards and coordinated platform-level intervention.

articles.title: Meta Releases Llama 4 Scout Fine-Tuning Toolkit for On-Device Deployment
articles.summary: Meta open-sourced a specialized fine-tuning toolkit designed to optimize Llama 4 Scout models for on-device inference on smartphones and edge hardware. The toolkit includes quantization utilities and LoRA adapters tested on both Android and iOS platforms. Developers have already begun sharing fine-tuned variants for healthcare, legal, and education verticals on Hugging Face.

articles.title: Perplexity AI Raises $500M Series E, Valuation Hits $14 Billion
articles.summary: AI-powered search startup Perplexity AI closed a $500 million Series E funding round, pushing its valuation to $14 billion and cementing its position as one of the most valuable AI search companies. The round was led by a consortium of sovereign wealth funds alongside existing investors. Perplexity plans to use the capital to expand its agentic search features and grow its international user base.
